about: Stylesheet rules that may hide what they style, each by its selector, the declarations it may use (and no others), and why. The lead's file: the numbers stage refuses a hiding declaration unless its selector is named here with that declaration, because a stylesheet could otherwise hide a figure or its source while every page check passes. A layout that swaps one view for another names both selectors here.

.map .axis.why: the map's axis: SVG paths drawn as strokes, with fill:none so they are not filled in; they hold no text

.map .edge.why: the map's arrows: SVG paths drawn as strokes, with fill:none so their curves are not filled in; they hold no text
